Generate an automated bibliometric report

biblio_report.Rd

Produces an auditable report with corpus health, descriptive metrics, annual growth, leading terms, network centrality, backend availability and provenance.

Usage

biblio_report(
  x,
  output_file = "biblio-report.md",
  format = c("markdown", "html", "docx", "pdf"),
  title = "Bibliometric Analysis Report"
)

Arguments

x

A data frame or biblio_project.

output_file

Destination file.

format

"markdown", "html", "docx", or "pdf".

title

Report title.

Value

Normalized report path.

Examples

f<-tempfile(fileext=".md"); biblio_report(example_biblio(),f); file.exists(f)
#> [1] "C:/Users/wep69/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpaiVm2d/file838c142d2c65.md"
#> [1] TRUE
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".md")
x <- as_biblio_project(example_biblio())
biblio_report(x, f, title = "Agronomy map")
#> [1] "C:/Users/wep69/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpaiVm2d/file838c6f15863.md"
# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE)) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
  biblio_report(example_biblio(), f, "html")
}
#> [1] "C:/Users/wep69/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpaiVm2d/file838c20b831ea.html"
# }
